career_ladder.note: Village Panchayat Secretaries (Talati cum Mantri) serve as administrative heads of Gram Panchayats under the Gujarat Panchayat Service (Selection) Rules and Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993, responsible for land revenue records, birth/death registration, rural development scheme implementation, and Gram Sabha coordination.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Talati cum Mantri is governed by the Gujarat Panchayat Service Selection Board regulations via a single-stage statewide OMR Written Examination (100 marks, 60 minutes) followed by Document Verification. Negative marking is 0.33 marks per wrong answer; selecting Option 'E' (Not Attempted) incurs no deduction.

financial_package.note: Under the Gujarat Government's Fix Pay Policy, Talati cum Mantri appointees serve on a 5-year fixed remuneration of ₹26,000 per month (enhanced from ₹19,950 in October 2023). Upon satisfactory completion of 5 years, incumbents are regularized into Pay Matrix Level 2 (₹19,950–₹63,200 with entry basic ₹19,950) under the Gujarat Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Gujarat Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules Schedule Level 2
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 2 entry basic pay of ₹19,950 at 58% DA (₹11,571 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (10% to 18%: ₹1,995 to ₹3,591 for rural and semi-urban panchayat postings), Traveling Allowance, net of NPS deduction (10% of Basic+DA = ₹3,152) and Professional Tax (₹200).
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Gujarat Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) applicable to rural and semi-urban panchayat jurisdictions
Panchayat conveyance allowance and official bicycle / moped conveyance subsidy
Fixed Medical Allowance (FMA) and leave encashment benefits upon regularization
Pension coverage under National Pension System (NPS) following 5-year probation
